'''Moss giants''' are the guardian spirits of [[Glarial's Tomb]], and are significantly larger than ordinary [[moss giant]]s. They are encountered during the [[Waterfall Quest]] when the player enters the tomb to obtain [[Glarial's amulet]], and must later be killed during the [[Roving Elves]] quest to obtain the [[consecration seed]]. They can only be fought unarmed, as it is impossible to take weapons, armour, ammunition or runes into the tomb.

==Update history==
{{UH|
* {{UL|type=update|update=Patch Notes: Part 2 - Combat Style Modernisation|date=2 March 2026}}
** Default base hit chances increased:
*** Magic ('weak'): 65 → 70
*** Melee ('same'): 55 → 60
*** Ranged ('strong'): 45 → 50

* {{UL|type=ninja|update=This Week In RuneScape: Yak To Basics and Ninja Strike 20!|date=1 March 2021}}
** Moss giants now attack with melee and are weak to fire spells. Some moss giants' levels and stats were also changed.

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Patch Notes (18 March 2013)|date=18 March 2013}}
** [[Grotworm]]s, moss giants, [[banshee]]s, [[jungle spider]]s, [[shadow spider]]s, [[spider]]s, [[giant spider]]s, [[deadly red spider]]s, [[ice spider]]s, [[scorpion]]s, [[Poison Scorpion]]s and [[Pit Scorpion]]s will no longer hit for 1 hit point worth of damage.

* {{UL|type=update|update=Roving Elves|date=7 February 2005}}
** Added to game.
}}

==Trivia==
* The examine, "Bigger than your average moss giant." is a play on Yogi the Bear's words, "Smarter than your average bear".
